title: Add a Task QA
eyebrow: Built and checked in a real browser · ready for you to test · issues #239 to #242

short.lead: You can now add a task to a project from every screen. The jotter at the top has a 'To: Unsorted' stamp that can send a task straight to a project. Each project card and the Board (once you pick a project) have a one-line 'Add a task' row: type, press Enter, done. Everything is on the branch ccr-bfad8420-d02at0. The app only goes live on your site when a change reaches main, so the pictures below are taken from the built app with sample data.
short.hint: Tap a step to see what to try and what you should see.
items: Every project card ends in a dashed 'Add a task…' row. The task goes into that project's Up next, the box empties and stays ready for the next one. 'More' opens steps, priority, due date and labels.
On the Projects screen, type a task in a card's row and press Enter. Then press More, pick a priority and a date, and add another.

items.alt: A project card on a phone with the add row and More open showing steps, priority, a date and the due-date stage step
items.caption: A project card with More open, on a phone.

items: If a sync arrives while you are typing in a row, your text is kept (the problem in issue #235).
Start typing in a row, then make a change on another device or tab and wait for it to arrive. Your text should still be there.

items.alt: Two project cards in dark mode; Home's row still holds 'Half-typed thought' after the School card received a task from another tab
items.caption: The text survived another tab's save, in dark mode.

items: With a project chosen in the Board's project menu, an 'Add a task to <project>…' row sits above Up next. With 'Project: All', or on the other tabs, it is hidden.
On the Board, choose a project, type a task in the row and press Enter. It should appear in the list at once.

items.alt: The Board on a phone showing School with an Add a task to School row above three cards
items.caption: The Board with School chosen, on a phone.

items: Send a task straight to a project

Left on 'To: Unsorted', the jotter works as before. Pick a project and Add becomes 'Add task'; a notice says where the task went, and Open takes you to it on the Board. On the Board with a project chosen, the stamp starts on that project by itself. Changing screen puts it back.
On the Focus screen, set the stamp to a project, type a task and press Enter. Press Open on the notice.

items.alt: The Focus screen on a phone with the jotter stamp set to Home, an Add task button, and a notice reading Added Jotted straight to Home to Home with an Open button
items.caption: The jotter set to Home, with the notice, on a phone.

items: Your reply moves the issues on.
Reply 'QA passed: add a task anywhere', or say what's wrong.
